tool_args.rationale: The target horizon of 24.5 is far beyond the pilot range of 0.16–0.48. A slow-horizon probe directly distinguishes endogenous reversal from short-window alternatives and constrains the slow timescale.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the dual-exponential adaptation model to the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five closely spaced short-horizon observations cannot reliably identify both timescales or the long-horizon reversal.
The principal ambiguity concerns slow-horizon behavior, not fine resolution within the short pilot window.
It remains plausible over the pilot window but cannot establish whether slow adaptation reverses the response.
